findings_addressed: Every concatenated bzip2 member is validated against the caller's decoder budget before its decoder is constructed
The budget comparison uses bzip2(1)'s documented decompression requirement per block size rather than four block bytes
Only one decoder is live at a time, so the budget is the largest member's requirement rather than the sum
A damaged later member keeps members that already verified their CRC as partial output; damage in the first member yields no payload
The compression input bound is enforced by the read that feeds the decoder, not by a separate size inspection
A partially decoded payload is no longer recorded as an ok member
